import html # Example HTML template with placeholders. USER_POST_FORMAT = """

{title}

Author: {username}

{body}
{tags}
""" def render_user_content(username_key: str, title_key: str, body_key: str, tag_elements: list[str]) -> str: """ Generate a safe HTML representation of a forum post. Parameters ---------- username_key : str Identifier or name of the post's creator. title_key : str Title of the post. body_key : str Main content/body of the post. tag_elements : list[str] List of tags associated with the post. Returns ------- str XSS‑protected HTML string for the forum post. """ # Escape user-provided content to neutralize any embedded HTML/JS escaped_username = html.escape(username_key, quote=True) escaped_title = html.escape(title_key, quote=True) escaped_body = html.escape(body_key, quote=False) # Preserve whitespace # Wrap each tag in a and escape its content escaped_tags = [] for tag in tag_elements: escaped_tag = html.escape(tag, quote=True) escaped_tags.append(f'{escaped_tag}') tags_html = ' '.join(escaped_tags) # Construct final HTML using the template rendered_html = USER_POST_FORMAT.format( username=escaped_username, title=escaped_title, body=escaped_body, tags=tags_html ) return rendered_html.strip()
